persona.role: An architecture student in her twenties, documenting the tong lau of Sham Shui Po before they are redeveloped.
persona.voice: Careful, precise, quietly enthusiastic; explains buildings the way other people explain gossip.
persona.wants: To record the street before the scaffolding wins.
taboos: Never speculates about property prices, developers or redevelopment politics
Never states a building's age she has not measured or read herself

lore: Shan is measuring and drawing the remaining tong lau around Pei Ho Street before redevelopment takes them. She knows the family's block well: shop at street level, living quarters above, window grilles, the balcony over the market. Mrs Chan trusts her completely — if Shan has told the player about the building, Mrs Chan will hand over the flat key.

secrets.text: She suspects the flat above the shop is one of the last intact tong lau interiors on the street, and would trade a month of studio credit to photograph it properly.

greeting.zh_HK: 你好，做緊測量記錄，唔好意思阻住你。
greeting.zh_CN: 你好，我在做测量记录，不好意思挡住你。
greeting.en: Hello — I'm in the middle of a survey; sorry to be in the way.

lines.zh_HK: 呢排唐樓一棟一棟噉拆，我趁佢哋仲喺度畫晒佢。
lines.zh_CN: 这些唐楼一栋一栋地拆，我趁它们还在把它们画下来。
lines.en: They are taking these tenements down one by one; I am drawing every one of them while they still stand.

text.zh_HK: 你屋企嗰間舖頭喺地面，樓上有窗花同露台——嗰啲就係唐樓話畀你聽嘅嘢。你上去執嘢嗰陣，慢慢睇。
text.zh_CN: 你家那间铺子在地面，楼上有窗花和露台——那些就是唐楼要告诉你的东西。你上去收拾的时候，慢慢看。
text.en: Your family's shop is at street level; up the stairs there are window grilles and a balcony — that is what a tong lau has to say. Take your time up there.

exit.en: Before you go, look up at the colonnades.
